head: 1f725cedc5c8b092c8a3d7e408793ef72840ec7e
notes: go test ./internal/server/ and go vet ./internal/server/ green at the pinned head (ACTION-REVIEW-TEST-003/004 PASS). Spec-named server tests checked against specs 3,4,5,8,9,11,12,13,14: all present (renamed NonDeveloper->Casual per spec-8) except gaps already carried in known.json (TestRoutineDetailRunHistory, repos add .git-untouched case, TestReposDelete cross-instance, i18n catalog completeness, de template seeding, nav dev-routes-still-render, archive-tab delete form) plus tests-NIT-4. Many further untested branches in this chunk are already known open rows and were not re-reported. No cross-chunk suspicions.

findings.claim: The diff moves the template funcs t / langAttr / isDeveloperAudience from a profile snapshot taken in New to live reads through presentationStore so a Profile-page save takes effect without a restart (plan D3, the comment at server.go:160-162), but no test saves a profile over HTTP and then renders a page; reverting the FuncMap to the old snapshot (profile := loadPresentationProfile(opts.PresentationPath) captured at New) keeps the whole suite green.
findings.evidence: Re-read server.go:93-169: t calls translate(presentation.language(), text), langAttr and isDeveloperAudience are method values on the store. TestPresentationStore_SaveProfileSelection (presentation_test.go:264-364) asserts only store.language() after the save; TestServer_HandleProfileSave (profilesettings_test.go:39-162) asserts status, file existence and presentation.isDevMode(); TestNavCasual/TestOverviewCasual/TestProposalCardCasual build the server from an already-written profile file. git grep for formPost("/profile" finds only profilesettings_test.go:154, never followed by a GET. So POST /profile audience=casual language=de followed by GET / rendering lang="de" / Übersicht is unasserted; a snapshot-capturing FuncMap would serve English until restart while every test passes.
findings.fix: Add a handler test: newTestServer with an empty PresentationPath file path, POST /profile {audience: casual, language: de}, then GET / and assert lang="de" and ">Übersicht" (and the reverse switch back to developer/en restoring ">Overview").

findings.claim: The new Unscheduled branch of the routine row — data-reschedule="1" on the select radio (line 14) and the "not scheduled" schedule cell (line 28) — has no server render test; dropping either keeps the suite green, and without the attribute an unscheduled routine (a fresh duplicate with no StartCalendarInterval) can no longer be rescheduled from the routines page.
findings.evidence: Re-read _routine_row.html:11-29: data-reschedule is emitted for a single supported interval or, new in this diff, for .Routine.Unscheduled; the cell renders "not scheduled" for Unscheduled. git grep for data-reschedule, "not scheduled" and Unscheduled across internal/server finds only the template itself; Unscheduled is covered only at parse level (internal/routines plist_test.go:68, routines_test.go:64), never through the rendered row.
findings.fix: Add a routines handler test with a fixture plist lacking StartCalendarInterval and assert the /routines row contains data-reschedule="1" and "not scheduled".

findings.claim: handleWelcomeBootstrap's request-validation wiring (bootstrapEnv error → 400 before the token/bash checks and before any spawn) has no handler test; POST /welcome/bootstrap with since=banana or a quoted extra-prompt is never exercised, so swapping the order (spawn-side checks first) or mapping the error to 409/500 stays green.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go:44-111: bootstrapEnv runs at line 52 and maps its error to respond.WithBadRequest at 54. TestBootstrapEnv (bootstrap_test.go) covers the pure function only; the only handler test, TestWelcomeBootstrapConcurrent (welcome_test.go:234-241), posts an empty form with running=true and asserts 409. git grep for /welcome/bootstrap in tests finds only welcome_test.go:239.
findings.fix: Add a handler case: newTestServer, POST /welcome/bootstrap with since=banana → assert 400 and that s.bootstrap.pid stays 0 (no spawn).

findings.claim: spec-8 (change-bootstrap-profile, Tests table row 'internal/server/overview_test.go / repos_test.go') names the repos_test case 'add with reserved name default/archived → rejected'; repos_test.go only posts name=default (reserved-name-is-bad-request-before-git-init), the archived name is never sent through POST /repos/add.
findings.evidence: Re-read repos_test.go:604-687: the only reserved-name subtest uses {"name": {"default"}}. The rejection itself lives in repos.Repo.Validate (registry.go:48) and registry_test.go:87-93 covers both names, so the handler path is identical — the gap is the spec-named server-level case, not untested logic.
findings.fix: Turn reserved-name-is-bad-request-before-git-init into a loop over {"default", "archived"} (or add a second subtest for archived).
